old_problem: The historical review left this explicit WebUI factory-default workflow pending for its item/default matrix, vendor activation details and recovery. DeepSeek additionally invented a generic Redfish ResetType and used firmware reachability as a false preservation oracle.
disposition_reason: The Master supplies the operative OEM surface and semantics: choose Preserve items in BMC WebUI, click Start and validate that selected values survive Factory Default. ED-03 allows standard discovery but forbids guessing OEM API payloads; therefore execution stays on the source WebUI unless a vendor-documented API is separately signed. ED-15/17/20/30 require a complete selected/unselected default oracle, configuration backup, preserved evidence, independent access recovery and one-shot authorization. Those are runtime gates, not reasons to leave the review pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2211, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2212 / Wistron-BMC-01062-V002 / 30c65d39e84d4561 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Use the exact BMC WebUI Preserve plus Factory Default Start workflow stated by the source; do not assume Redfish Manager.Reset supports `FactoryReset`.
Bind exact BMC/SUT/firmware, every Preserve item, selected state and representative selected/unselected before values plus documented defaults.
Export recoverable configuration and establish independent console/physical access because accounts, network, certificates and services may reset.
Obtain separate one-shot destructive authorization; record the approximately three-minute expectation but use a signed readiness timeout rather than fixed blind sleep.
After recovery, selected values must remain identical and all governed unselected values must equal documented defaults; firmware version/reachability alone cannot PASS.
Preserve SEL/host/audit evidence, use secret-safe trusted access, stop after the first reset anomaly and never retry automatically.
No login, Preserve selection, backup, reset, query, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: BMC WebUI Factory Default with item-level Preserve and default matrix validation
test_case.purpose: Verify one approved BMC Factory Default operation resets the governed non-preserved settings to documented defaults while every explicitly selected Preserve item remains unchanged and the BMC returns to healthy manageable service.
required_package: BMC/SUT/firmware identity and source-approved WebUI Factory Default/Preserve workflow
Complete Preserve item inventory, selected-state and selected/unselected before/default matrix
Recoverable configuration export plus accounts/network/certificate/service/log scope
Trusted credential-safe WebUI access, one-shot destructive authorization and readiness timeout
Independent console/physical recovery, final desired configuration and restore plan
test_case.test_command: After target verification, configuration export, matrix approval and separate one-shot authorization, the authorized operator logs in to the trusted BMC WebUI, confirms the exact Preserve selections, records screenshots and clicks the source-defined Factory Default Start once. Record outage and readiness rather than using a blind sleep. After management returns, collect the complete setting matrix: prove selected values are unchanged, governed unselected values equal documented defaults, and account/network/certificate/service/log plus BMC/host health meet signed criteria. Restore only the approved final configuration.
test_case.expected_result: The single approved WebUI factory-default action completes within signed readiness limits; every selected Preserve value remains identical; every governed non-preserved value equals its documented default; authorized management access and platform health recover; final configuration matches the approved state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when the exact pre/selected/default/post matrix proves both preservation and reset semantics and recovery/health criteria pass. Any selected-value change, non-preserved value not at documented default, partial reset, lost access, reset loop, health fault or failed final restoration is FAIL. Missing matrix, backup, authorization or recovery is BLOCKED at execution; firmware version, HTTP response or reachability alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact BMC, complete matrix/default oracle, recoverable backup, independent access, final-state plan and one-shot destructive approval are signed.
Use the source WebUI; no guessed `FactoryReset`/OEM API payload, insecure TLS, inline secret or credential capture.
Preserve SEL/host/audit evidence before the reset; do not clear logs.
Issue at most one approved Factory Default; stop on access loss, partial semantics, reset loop or health fault and invoke operator recovery without retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, BMC/SUT/firmware and authenticated WebUI identity
Configuration export, full Preserve inventory/selections and selected/unselected before/default matrix
Owner approval and timestamped screenshots/audit of Preserve confirmation and single Start action
Outage/readiness timeline and complete post-reset matrix proving preserved and defaulted values
Recovery, final-configuration restore, discrepancy and engineer-verdict record
test_case.recovery: On lost access, partial reset, changed preserved value, reset loop or health fault, do not retry Factory Default. Preserve all reachable evidence, use the independent console/physical path to restore approved network/account access and the signed configuration backup, verify BMC/host health, and escalate any unrecoverable setting to the vendor/platform owner.
